words.zh: n. 城堡；堡垒；（国际象棋中的）车
words.example: The old castle stands on a hill above the small river.

words.zh: v. 申请；应用；适用；涂，施于；实施，施加；【航】施加，涂抹
words.example: You should apply before the end of this month.

words.zh: phr. 申请
words.example: She plans to apply for a part-time job at the library.

words.zh: n. 签证
words.example: He needs a student visa to study in Canada.

words.zh: n. 租金；  v. 出租；租
words.example: The rent for this small apartment is quite high.

words.zh: v. 收拾，打包；把......包起来；装箱；塞满，挤满；聚集；  n. 行李；背包；（商品的）纸包，纸袋；小盒，小包；群；  adj. 包装用的；搬运用的；由驮运牲畜组成的
words.example: I will pack my suitcase tonight because the train leaves early tomorrow.

words.zh: adj. 令人惊奇的，令人惊喜的；了不起的；  v. 使受惊（amaze的ing形式）
words.example: The view from the top of the mountain was truly amazing.

words.zh: adj. 惊奇的，吃惊的；大为惊奇
words.example: She was amazed by the beautiful painting in the museum.

words.zh: n. 布置；安排；排列；准备，筹备；计划；协议；【化】排列
words.example: The arrangement of flowers on the table looked very nice.

words.zh: adv. 极其，非常；极端地
words.example: The weather was extremely cold last winter in our city.

words.zh: n. 来源；出处；河的源头；根源；原始资料；知情人士；  v. 获得
words.example: The river is the main source of water for the town.

words.zh: adj. 狭窄的，窄小的；差距小的，微小的；（想法、态度或信仰）狭隘的；有限的；  n. 海峡；狭窄部分；  v. （使）变窄；使缩小，压缩
words.example: The narrow street is too small for two cars to pass.

words.zh: n. 公寓；平面；一套房间；  adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(费率，价格或百分比)固定的；浅的；单调的；平滑的；【数】平坦的，扁平的；  adv. 平直地
words.example: They live in a small flat near the city center.

words.zh: adj. 强有力的；有权势的，有影响力的；效能高的；很有效的；  adv. 很；非常
words.example: The engine of this racing car is extremely powerful.

words.zh: n. 帝国；（由个人或集团控制的）大企业；  adj. 新古典风格的
words.example: The Roman Empire once controlled a large part of Europe.

words.zh: n. 皇帝
words.example: The emperor ordered a new palace to be built.

words.zh: v. 选址；使坐落；  n. 场所；地点；网站；现场；位置；遗址；建筑工地
words.example: They decided to site the new factory near the railway station.

words.zh: phr. 控制，接管
words.example: After the captain was injured, the vice-captain had to take control of the team.

words.zh: n. 官员；裁判；委员；公务员，高级职员；  adj. 官方的，正式的；公务的，公职的；有权威的
words.example: The government official visited our school to talk about environmental protection.

words.zh: v. 辨认出，识别；承认，认可；认识
words.example: I didn't recognise my old friend because he had changed so much.

words.zh: n. 类型，种类；典型 ；铅字；【计】类型；  v. 打字；【医学】测定（血型）；按类型把…归类；成为…的典型；【印刷】浇铸（铅字等）
words.example: What type of music do you prefer, pop or classical?

words.zh: v. 使球在空中飞行；  n. 航班；航程；空中航行；楼梯的一段；逃跑；【航】航班，飞行
words.example: The striker learned how to flight the ball accurately towards the goal.

words.zh: n. 住宿，膳宿；调解；住处，停留处；工作场所；适应
words.example: We booked cheap accommodation near the beach for our summer holiday.

words.zh: adj. 独一无二的，独特的；唯一的；特有的；不同寻常的；罕见的；【计】唯一的
words.example: Each snowflake has a unique shape that is different from all others.

words.zh: n. 小路；道路；路线；（尤指达到某一目的或结果的）行动步骤，途径；【计】路径；【物】路径；【电】通路
words.example: We walked along a narrow path through the forest to reach the lake.

words.zh: n. 目的地；终点；  adj. 目的地的
words.example: After a long journey, we finally arrived at our destination at sunset.

words.zh: phr. 除了...之外；不同于
words.example: Other than a small scratch, the car was completely undamaged in the accident.

words.zh: vt. 钦佩，崇拜；喜欢，羡慕；赞赏；欣赏
words.example: I really admire my English teacher for her patience and kindness.

words.zh: n. 建筑学；建筑体系；（总称）建筑物；结构；建筑风格，建筑设计；建筑业
words.example: The modern architecture of the new library attracts many visitors every day.

words.zh: n. 设计师；建筑师
words.example: The famous architect designed a beautiful bridge that connects the two cities.

words.zh: n. 手册，小册子；资料(或广告)手册
words.example: The travel brochure showed many beautiful photos of Paris and Rome.

words.zh: n. 包裹；包装盒；一揽子，一整套；包，袋；包价（旅游）；成套出售的东西，套餐；【计】包；  v. 将……包装好
words.example: I received a small package from my cousin who lives in Shanghai.

words.zh: phr. 包价旅游
words.example: They prefer a package tour because it includes flights, hotels, and meals.

words.zh: v. 接触；联系；  n. 接触；联系，联络；联系人，熟人；隐形眼镜；联系人；  adj. 保持接触的；由接触引起的；【航】可看见地面景物的；  adv. 【航】以目力观察（飞行）
words.example: Please contact me by email if you have any questions about the homework.

words.zh: n. 文明（=civilization）；文明世界；文化
words.example: The ancient Chinese civilisation made great contributions to human history.

words.zh: phr. 构成，形成；补足；化妆；编造
words.example: Four main islands make up the country of Japan.

words.zh: n. 士兵，军人；兵蚁；偷懒者；  vi. 当兵；坚持不懈，迎难而上
words.example: The young soldier bravely protected his country during the war.

words.zh: v. 使产生身临其境的感觉；流放（读作/trænsˈpɔrt/）；【化】运输，转移；  vt. 运输，运送；  n. 运输；流放犯；交通运输系统（读作/ˈtrænsˌpɔrt/）；交通车辆，运输工具；旅行方式
words.example: The amazing sound effects transport the audience into the middle of the battle.

words.zh: n. 远足，徒步旅行；（数量、价格等）增加，上升；  v. 徒步旅行；去......远足；使高涨，提高（价格）
words.example: We went on a long hike through the mountains and enjoyed the fresh air.

words.zh: n. 经济；节约；经济制度
words.example: The country's economy has grown rapidly because of new technology.

words.zh: adj. 经济上的，经济学的；合算的；有利可图的
words.example: The government introduced new economic policies to create more jobs.

words.zh: n. 荣誉；有权得到的款项；学分；借款；赊购，信贷；称赞；债权；信用；【财】信用，信贷；  v. 信赖；认为是……的功劳；记学分
words.example: She received full credit for organizing the successful school concert.

words.zh: phr. 信用卡
words.example: I used my credit card to buy the tickets for the train.

words.zh: n. 细节；详情；特遣队；（关于某事物的）资料，信息；  v. 详细说明；派遣
words.example: He told us every detail of his trip to Beijing, including the food.

words.zh: phr. 登记（在旅馆、机场等）；报到，记录
words.example: You need to check in at the airport at least two hours before your flight.

words.zh: phr. 结账离开；检验；通过考核，合格；调查，检查；察看，观察（有趣或有吸引力的人或事物）；借阅，借出
words.example: We decided to check out of the hotel early in the morning.

words.zh: n. （正式或礼貌的）请求；要求；需要；【计】请求；  v. 请求，要求
words.example: The teacher made a request that all students hand in their homework tomorrow.

words.zh: n. 风景，景色；视野；观点，看法；风景画，风景照；显示方式；（一次）观看；【计】视图；  v. 查看，观察；看待；观看，收看
words.example: From the top of the hill, we had a wonderful view of the whole city.

words.zh: n. 视力；景观，名胜；视野；看见；景象，情景；视觉；  v. 看见；  adj. 见票即付的；即席的
words.example: After using the computer for hours, my sight became a little blurry.

words.zh: n. 雕塑；雕像
words.example: There is a large statue of a famous scientist in the city square.

words.zh: abbr. 公元前
words.example: The ancient pyramids were built around 2560 BCE, which is over 4,500 years ago.

words.zh: n. 墓穴，坟墓；  vt. 埋葬
words.example: The archaeologists discovered an ancient tomb full of treasures and paintings.

words.zh: vt. 发掘，掘出；揭露，发现
words.example: The archaeologists hope to unearth ancient relics buried beneath the ruins.

words.zh: n. 评论；批评，指责；注释，解释；议论；意见；  v. 评论，表达意见；评价；表达意见
words.example: The teacher asked us to write a comment on the article.
